name: Mamurogawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mamurogawa town emblem in white: a stylised character of three horizontal strokes with a vertical bar and two discs.
history: Municipal flag of Mamurogawa, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 4 July 1972.

features.role: Mamurogawa town emblem — a stylised character of three horizontal strokes with a vertical bar and two discs
